newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank signs deals for working capital loans.
newsitem.headline: China bank signs deals for working capital loans.

text.p: The Industrial and Commercial Bank of China has signed contracts with 50 state-owned companies to provide working capital loans for the rest of 1997, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.

Under the deals, which were signed recently, the bank would continue to provide working capital loans to the 50 firms until the end of this year and would offer other financial services such as consulting and market research, the newspaper said.
The firms included Shanghai Petrochemical Co Ltd, Sichuan Changhong Electric Appliances Co Ltd, First Automotive Works and Yizheng Petrochemical Fibre Corp, the newspaper said.
The deals were part of a drive by the central government to focus state support on a handful of major state-owned firms, it said but did not elaborate.
The bank made 28 billion yuan ($3.37 billion) in working capital loans in 1996, it said.
